0x00076E.en: 「S-So this is as far as I go...!」

0x0007A0.en: 「With my current skill level...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x000811.en: 「Kh!@ So this is as far as I go...!!」

0x000899.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x000913.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x0009C2.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A6E.en: 「Nngh, so this is as far as I go!」

0x000AC3.en: 「Kh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000AFE.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny at all...」

0x000B52.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to eject...」

0x000BC6.en: 「Ngh! I've got no choice but to pull back!!」

0x000C3C.en: 「So this is as far as I go......!」

0x000CA3.en: 「So this is as far as I go...... The rest is up to you.」

0x000CD5.en: 「Damn it...!@　Is this as far as I go!」

0x000D4F.en: 「No good, I've taken too much damage...... Retreating!」

0x000D9C.en: 「Well, this is a fix. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DDA.en: 「Kyaa! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E21.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000ECC.en: 「Kh...... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star...... I'm ejecting!」

0x000F83.en: 「Ow-ow-ow...... You got me, that was a miscalculation.」

0x000FC4.en: 「Oh dear, I've gone and gotten myself done in!」

0x001008.en: 「U...ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001075.en: 「Kh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010BC.en: 「I'm sorry, I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0010F1.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as my strength goes...!」

0x0011DD.en: 「To be taken down in a place like this...@　How green of me...!」

0x00122B.en: 「No good, this is all I can take! Retreating!」

0x0012A4.en: 「Sorry!@　I'm going to have to pull out...!」

0x0012E6.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001315.en: 「Oh no! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001353.en: 「Good grief, so this is as far as I go.」

0x001382.en: 「I can't take any more. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x00140D.en: 「Was I careless...@　I'll be pulling back here...!」

0x00148A.en: 「Tch...! I couldn't hold out after all...!」

0x001573.en: 「I'm ejecting...@　Kh...! I couldn't pull it off with any style...」

0x001771.en: 「So this is as far as I go!!」

0x001843.en: 「Aw man, they've gone and done me in.」

0x001963.en: （...The left shoulder Vernier thruster is broken.@　And the left wrist's dampening stabilizer isn't responding either.）

0x0019E9.en: （Output has fallen to 30%......@　Forty seconds until the OS is optimized......）

0x001A4B.en: （It's only a little further to the visible area...）

0x001A7C.en: （If those guys from before catch up to me...）

0x001AD5.en: （If there's a god in this world,@　please, just give me 60... no, 30 more seconds...!）

0x001B65.en: （A new pursuer... and it's not just a Canis this time.）

0x001BCA.en: （But I won't die here without even knowing why. The Steel Dragons... that phrase is the key to my memories... to who I am... that answer...）

0x001C90.en: （Optimization complete... but they've caught up to me.）

0x001DA8.en: 「We're Idealants...@　by rights, we should be at the top.」

0x001E0A.en: 「And yet those mysterious upstarts@　are the Alphas... I won't accept it.」

0x001E7B.en: 「Each Saber squad has its own distinct specialty.@　The name does not determine superiority, by my judgment.」

0x001F50.en: 「We're in the middle of an exercise. That action is not authorized.@　We need to wait for orders from HQ.」

0x001FCD.en: 「If we do that, he'll get away.」

0x00200D.en: 「Acting alone is forbidden.@　Why not just take him into custody?」

0x00209D.en: 「Roger.@　...You there, state your squad and identification.」

0x0020F0.en: 「I don't mind if you won't give your name...@　but disarm your weapons at once and surrender.」

0x002192.en: 「I cannot let you leave the Shade.@　I will take drastic measures.」

0x0021FD.en: 「I... can't let myself be captured here.」

0x002234.en: 「Then I will stop that machine and take you into custody.」

0x002280.en: （...If she's saying she won't kill me, then there's a way through.）

0x0022C3.en: （If I can somehow make it over there...）

0x0022FA.en: （I can reach the visible area of the Satellite Seeker...!）

0x002349.en: （I've made it this far, so now all that's left is...!）

0x002377.en: 「You're too soft, Ariel.@　Do you plan on letting him escape?」

0x002479.en: （Alpha... the Fau Kern in Alles...@　and now this incident... There are so many@　suspicious things about the Gaia Sabers...）

0x00250C.en: （And the death of Professor Ozunu, too...）
